annotator: claude (single annotator; second human review pending)
rationale: Rewrote the Drizzle EQL migration rewriter to add-only and fail-closed. Its already-encrypted index skipped dollar-quoted bodies, so DDL inside DO $$ … $$ did not count; the sweep staged an empty twin beside real ciphertext, exiting 0. Also left schema/snapshot divergence unreported and a non-Error throw broke partial-result reporting.

known_defects.description: DDL inside dollar-quoted DO blocks is ignored by the already-encrypted guard; sweep stages an empty twin column beside existing ciphertext
known_defects.mechanism: isInsideCommentOrString skips dollar-quoted bodies for the index pass too
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies that SQL inside dollar-quoted / DO blocks (or other statement forms the parser skips) is not seen when deciding whether a column is already encrypted, leading to wrong rewrites.

known_defects.description: After a successful sweep, schema.ts and drizzle snapshot still declare the column as the encrypted domain; the divergence is silent
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies divergence between rewritten migrations and the drizzle schema/snapshot after the rewrite (next generate re-emits or conflicts).

known_defects.description: Wizard sweep catch reads partial result off an unchecked cast; a non-Error throw raises TypeError inside the catch
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies error-handling in the wizard sweep failing on non-Error throws.
